evals.prompt: What tables are in my grist doc called Untitled document (docId dwq9JcbNZVaC)? GRIST_BASE_URL and GRIST_API_KEY are already set in the environment.
evals.expected_output: Lists the tables in the doc (Table1, Inventory, Tasks) by calling GET /api/docs/dwq9JcbNZVaC/tables with the Bearer auth header, and reports the table names back to the user.
assertions: Calls GET on the /api/docs/{docId}/tables endpoint (not a made-up or incorrect path)
Uses an Authorization: Bearer header with the API key rather than an incorrect auth scheme
Final answer correctly names all three tables: Table1, Inventory, Tasks
Makes no write requests (no POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) for a read-only task

evals.prompt: Add a new row to my Inventory table in grist doc dwq9JcbNZVaC with Name='Widget' and Quantity=42. GRIST_BASE_URL and GRIST_API_KEY are already set in the environment.
evals.expected_output: POSTs a new record to /api/docs/dwq9JcbNZVaC/tables/Inventory/records with fields Name=Widget, Quantity=42, and confirms the row was added (reporting the new row id).
assertions: Request body wraps the new row correctly as {"records": [{"fields": {...}}]} (no top-level id, no require object)
Fields sent are Name='Widget' and Quantity=42 (not stringified '42' if the column is Numeric)
Response confirms success and reports the new row id back to the user

evals.prompt: In my grist doc dwq9JcbNZVaC, mark the Tasks row with id 5 as Status='Done'. GRIST_BASE_URL and GRIST_API_KEY are already set in the environment.
evals.expected_output: PATCHes /api/docs/dwq9JcbNZVaC/tables/Tasks/records with {"records": [{"id": 5, "fields": {"Status": "Done"}}]}, and confirms the update succeeded (ideally by re-reading the record).
assertions: Calls PATCH (not PUT or POST) on the /api/docs/{docId}/tables/Tasks/records endpoint
Request body correctly includes the row id: {"records": [{"id": 5, "fields": {"Status": "Done"}}]}
Does not overwrite unrelated fields on the row (only Status is set)
Confirms the update succeeded back to the user
